ask: C++17, header-only. lru.hpp and test.cpp: LRU cache template LRU<K,V> with capacity, get/put/erase/size, std::list + std::unordered_map, move semantics. test.cpp exercises eviction order, updates, and a 10000-entry stress loop with a small assert harness. write the files.
prose:
Both files are written. Here's a quick summary of what's in each:

`lru.hpp` — The `LRU<K,V>` template uses a `std::list<pair<K,V>>` for O(1) splice-to-front (MRU promotion) and an `std::unordered_map<K, list_iterator>` for O(1) lookup. `get` promotes on hit and returns `std::optional<std::reference_wrapper<V>>` so callers get a live reference without copying. `put` does an in-place move on update. `erase` unlinks from both structures. The class is move-only.

`test.cpp` covers:
- Eviction order across sequential inserts
- Update promoting an existing key to MRU
- `erase` removing an entry and freeing a slot cleanly
- `get` promoting a key (shifting which entry gets evicted next)
- `size`/`capacity`/`empty`
- Move construction and move assignment
- Capacity-of-one edge case
- Two stress loops — a straight 10 000-entry sequential insert verifying the final 100 survive, and an interleaved get/put loop verifying repeatedly-touched keys are never evicted

Build and run:
```
g++ -std=c++17 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -o test test.cpp && ./test
```
